newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ONE REPO DEAL STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGES.
newsitem.headline: ONE REPO DEAL STRUCK ON BULGARIA EXCHANGES.

text.p: One seven-day repo deal in treasury paper worth of 20.5 million levs was struck on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) as as no corporate stocks traded on Bulgarian bourses for a ninth day in row, brokers said.
The paper yields 4.96 percent until repurchase.
Wednesday's repo turnover amounted to 6.0 million levs.
The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Wednesday's 41.28 points.
